VA Home Loans 101 Recap #vahomeloans 

What a night! We had an incredible turnout at our VA Home Loan 101 Seminar held at Mr. Gatti’s Pizza in Killeen on July 31st. From free food to valuable home-buying insights, this event was packed with helpful information and great conversations.

📣 Special thanks to guest speaker Danny Reyna, U.S. Air Force Veteran and Branch Manager (NMLS ID #363294), for breaking down everything from VA loan eligibility to smart homebuying strategies for military families.

🍕 Attendees enjoyed:

A free buffet and drinks

Expert advice on using VA loan benefits

Networking with other military families and local professionals

Tips on how to buy a home with confidence

📌 Why attend a VA Home Loan Seminar?
Answer: Events like this help veterans and active-duty members understand how to maximize their VA benefits, avoid common mistakes, and feel confident as they take steps toward homeownership.

🙌 Thank you to everyone who joined us—and if you missed this one, don’t worry! We’ll be hosting more VA Home Loan Info Nights soon.

📲 Want to learn more or attend the next one?
